objective: Implement PRD-defined input ingestion, attribution, normalization, redaction, persistence, and provenance capture.
implemented_behaviors: relia ingest --input accepts local JSON, JSON arrays, {"events": []} objects, and JSONL outcome streams.
Ingested events are recursively redacted and entropy-scanned before any experience shard is opened for write.
Known token shapes and secret-named fields are redacted in persisted canonical records.
Unclassified high-entropy values fail closed with exit 6 and do not create or update experience shards.
Canonical experience records are normalized to schemas/experience-record.schema.json shape and upserted into .relia/experiences/YYYY-MM.jsonl.
Each persisted experience requires a PR number and at least one https://github.com/ provenance URL; missing provenance exits 9.
Attribution is captured explicitly or inferred from configured PR labels, coauthor trailers, or agent authors; uncertain attribution is skipped by default.
